name: AutoVibe
tagline: See rims, tires and a lift kit on your own truck before you buy.
audience: Truck and car owners, and the tire and custom shops that serve them
before: You can't see what a lift kit or new rims will look like on your own vehicle, so you call around for shops and prices.
after: Snap a photo of your vehicle, try rims, tires and lift kits on it, and find local shops that carry them.
origin: The project that started VibeNinjaOS. Building it in one long AI chat fell apart, so we built a better way to work.
